Blackpowder

Blackpowder weapons share the feature Blackpowder.

  • Deadly: When you deal Severe damage, the target marks 1 extra HP.
  • Loud: The shot is noisy and attracts attention.
  • Reloading: After you attack, roll a d6. On a 1, mark 1 Stress to reload before firing again.

Dracheneisen is a rare, legendary alloy unique to Eisen. Dark and heavy with a faint metallic sheen, it is said to be forged with the remnants of ancient dragons. No new Dracheneisen items have been made in generations. All known pieces are heirlooms, trophies, or war relics sought by many factions. The secrets of their forging have been lost to time, or are kept very closely guarded.

Ironforged Weapons

Dracheneisen Weapons are Ironforged. These weapons have the following features:

  • Warforged. Increase the weapon’s damage by a static +5.
  • Mastercrafted. If the weapon is Reliable, increase that bonus by a further +1. If it is not Reliable, it gains Reliable.
  • Magical. The weapon bypasses supernatural resistances unless otherwise specified.

Ironbound Armours

Dracheneisen Armours are Ironbound. These pieces have the following features:

  • Resilient. Increase the armour’s base thresholds by +3.
  • Warded. Reduce incoming damage by the Armor Score before applying it to Thresholds.
  • Light. If the armour is Very Heavy, treat it as Heavy. If it is Heavy, ignore the trait.
